record_title: Equality cases in the universal spectral booksize bound
limitations: This is an exact equality classification, not a quantitative stability theorem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The full texts of Bollobas--Nikiforov (2005) and Berman--Zhang (2001) were not inspected in full; accessible descriptions do not state the classification, but unindexed observations remain a residual coverage risk. No independent validation is asserted.
